reason: The policy's modify_pending_order_items action only supports changing an item to a different option of the same product type ('each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option'), with new_item_ids required to match item_ids position-by-position for the same product. There is no policy provision for deleting items outright from a multi-item pending order while keeping others; cancellation only applies to an entire order. The candidate call passes new_item_ids=[] (empty) against item_ids=[3 items], which is not a same-product option swap but an outright removal/partial-refund action that the tool and policy do not support. No policy section authorizes partial item removal with refund from a pending order.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders.
